name: powerhouse-missing-connections-recovery
purpose: Detect and close missing Powerhouse couplings from current repository, database and production evidence without inventing parallel architecture or treating stale assumptions as truth.
trigger_when: auditing missing integrations, connectors, data flows or intelligence wiring
production tables or counts disagree with prior chat assumptions
a canonical PR exists but production still lacks its schema/runtime effects
checking whether social, search, analytics, portal, connector, decision-cycle or learning data is actually connected
required_behavior: Start from the existing canonical obligation and exact current PR head; never open a replacement lineage while the current one is valid.
Read live schema and runtime evidence before deciding that a table, connector, workflow or coupling is missing.
Distinguish configured capability, persisted evidence, successful execution, outcome evidence and terminal production proof.
Treat schema-name mismatches as discovery input, not permission to invent a second table or truth store.
Quantify structural gaps with current counts and freshness, including actions, decision cycles, events, economics, outcomes, forecasts, calibrations, connector definitions and executions.
Preserve evidence-first semantics: historical actions may be materialized only at the earliest truthful stage; later analysis, decisions, economics, feedback and outcomes require their own evidence.
Reuse canonical evidence/runtime authorities for analytics, search, social, external intelligence and portal state; no duplicate raw store or second Brain.
When CI is queued or pending, do not mutate speculatively. Wait for the first concrete failing assertion and repair only that root cause on the same lineage.
Before LIVE_AND_PROVEN, require exact-head gates, protected merge, production migration/deployment, runtime readback, outcome evidence and learning/prevention writeback.
Write the verified gap, root cause, evidence, recovery and prevention rule back to canonical Powerhouse learning and make this skill discoverable by chat preflight.
Register each newly introduced quality-critical function, RPC, API, route or table in the canonical quality-surface registry with executable evidence before expecting the discovery gate to pass.

Immediately before any LIVE_PROVEN, LIVE & BEWEZEN, PRODUCTION_GREEN or FULFILLED claim, refresh the current canonical candidate identity and build a complete terminal proof bundle from current authorities.
Treat a changed PR head as superseding terminal evidence from an earlier exact head for the active candidate.
To claim that no production write occurred, read the relevant production/provider mutation or audit authority directly; an unmerged PR or CI state alone is insufficient.
Append every terminal-claim evaluation, including incomplete proof, to the canonical activity ledger and write the resulting status plus evidence references back to shared Powerhouse state.
After learning/prevention writeback, prove next-agent discoverability by reading the same fingerprint or record through the canonical preflight/discovery route.
Before any repository write, read config/branch-delivery-ownership-guard.json through mandatory chat-learning preflight and inspect the canonical PR writer lease.
If Writer-Lease-State is TERMINAL_DELIVERY and this execution node is not the Writer-Lease-Owner, do not mutate the branch; defer and reuse the existing lineage.
The terminal lease remains active through exact-head gates, protected promotion, production/provider readback and learning writeback.

When required gates are terminal green and the change is within existing authority, invoke the canonical protected merge/promotion and production deploy or migration yourself; do not return routine production promotion to the user.
Continue after merge/deploy through production/provider readback, outcome/value verification, learning/prevention writeback and next-agent discoverability before terminal completion.
forbidden_patterns: claiming a missing connector from chat memory without current runtime/schema readback
creating parallel PRs or replacement architectures for an already-owned obligation
fabricating economics, feedback, causal proof, realized value or later decision-cycle stages
treating Netlify ready, a merge, migration file presence, configured connector or queued CI as terminal proof
retrying or changing code while required gates are merely queued and no concrete failure exists
adding a new quality-critical runtime surface without a canonical quality-surface registry entry and evidence contract
claiming LIVE_PROVEN from an earlier chat status, cached exact head, successful deploy acknowledgement or partial green checks
claiming that no production write occurred solely because a PR is open, unmerged, failed or cancelled
using evidence from a superseded exact head as terminal proof for the current candidate
mutating a canonical branch owned by another TERMINAL_DELIVERY writer lease
adding opportunistic improvements while exact-head terminal gates are running
telling the user to merge or deploy an already-authorized green candidate
stopping at preview or merge-ready when production promotion is within existing authority
